When the panel is viewed, all inactive switches are subtly glowing with a deep, ambient red light. To trigger the sequence, the viewer must interact by clicking specific buttons in the correct order. Upon successful input, the central windscreen section activates, simulating the spaceship entering hyperspace. This dynamic view is characterized by intense motion, displaying a tunnel composed of streaks and patterns defined by sharp, crystalline geometry.

statement: This sketch presents a futuristic spaceship control panel with interactive elements that respond to user input. The interface features illuminated switches and numbered buttons arranged in a visually cohesive layout. When viewed normally, the switches emit a subtle ambient red glow, creating an atmosphere of readiness. The system is activated by pressing buttons in a specific sequence (0, 2, 1, 3), which triggers the central windscreen to activate with a dynamic hyperspace tunnel effect. This transition creates a dramatic visual change that transforms the static control panel into an active space travel interface. The design balances aesthetic futurism with functional interactivity, demonstrating how a controlled environment can shift dramatically through user input.
